title: Commentary on Isaiah
blurb: Cyril of Alexandria's Commentary on Isaiah in a fresh English translation from the Greek, with passages from the prologue and from each of the five books.
first_english_note: This fresh English translation is made directly from the Greek of PG 70 and does not follow the wording of any earlier English version.

text_history.method: The English follows the Greek of PG 70 (CPG 5203). No modern English translation was used as a base.

scope: Selected passages from the prologue and from each of the five books
